controls.title: Group-based remuneration protection
controls.dimension: linked AccountRemuneration vs editable transaction source
controls.procedure: API integration:313-423 constructs a linked AccountRemuneration with a group; repository hydrate calculates protection, server rejects both reconcile and unreconcile.
controls.expected: Linked remuneration must block group reconciliation, regardless of source field.
controls.observed: Group computed reconcileProtected=true; both bulk commands rejected TRANSACTION_BULK_PROTECTED; unprotected control stays false.

controls.title: Golden Screen protected tooltip
controls.procedure: Chrome statement flow checks a disabled action with explanation; grouped protection is derived by API and UI data-reconcile-protected.
controls.expected: Disabled actions must explain why no eligible target is available.
controls.observed: Chrome records disabled unreconcile with tooltip and explanatory help; code maps protected group dataset to disabled controls.

controls.title: Legacy posted effectiveOn fallback
controls.procedure: PostgreSQL integration:178-201 clears effectiveOn on POSTED and reconciles, then asserts effectiveOn equals 2028-08-11 occurredOn not UTC today.
controls.expected: POSTED with NULL effectiveOn must use original occurredOn and preserve plannedOn.

controls.title: Saturation includes every active inherited family and requirement attack surface
controls.procedure: Run official check_delivery_saturation.py over the current requirement attack matrix, risk-saturation and inherited controls; assert all seven semantic-effect surfaces have primary negative-control references.
controls.expected: A family omitted while an inherited control remains active must fail; with all seven surfaces and their exact-family controls it must pass.
controls.observed: Pre-fix invocation failed exit 2 on missing semantic-effect. Corrected result-only risk saturation covers seven surfaces with 18 passed negative controls, and the same official invocation returned READY with exit 0.
